title: UserForecastPreferences
description: The forecasting configuration an actor has chosen: which forecast type, model preset and version, and training parameters applied when a model is retrained on their data.

forecast_type.description: Type of forecast model to train: deterministic (point) or stochastic (probabilistic).

training_ratio.description: Fraction of data used for training (e.g. 0.70).

validation_ratio.description: Fraction of data used for validation (e.g. 0.15).

test_ratio.description: Fraction of data used for testing (e.g. 0.15).

lookback_steps.description: Number of past timesteps used as input features for the model.

quantile_levels.description: Quantile levels to predict (for quantile regression models).

relatedToOptimizationInstance.description: Run these preferences were applied in.
